title: DetectionConfigEnvelope
description: Firestore `detection_config/latest` document (Story 1.13) — the post-auth OVERLAY that upgrades the Metro-bundled `map_config.<hud_version>.json` files between Play Store releases. Each config travels as its exact emitted JSON TEXT (`config_json`), never as a nested Firestore map: Firestore does not preserve map-key order, and `WardenRulePacker.orderedMapNames` recovers `minimap_identification.maps` order (= every map rule's texel index) from the raw text. `revision` lives here, not in the config (map-config.schema.json is `additionalProperties: false` with no version field); the app applies the overlay only when `revision` exceeds both its cached overlay revision and its shipped `BUNDLED_MAP_CONFIG_REVISION`. Operator rule (Story 1.16): next revision = max(current Firestore revision, shipped bundled revision) + 1. Built by `apps/tooling/tools/detection_config_envelope.py`. Size: the bundled v2 config is ~62 kB of text, so Firestore's 1 MiB document limit leaves room for roughly 15 HUD configs.

envelope_version.description: Envelope-shape version. A client that does not know the value rejects the whole document and keeps its bundled/cached config.

revision.description: Monotonic overlay revision. Clients apply the overlay only when it is strictly greater than the cached overlay revision AND the shipped bundled revision.

configs.description: HUD version -> config entry. The KNOWN keys are the `hud_version` enum of map-config.schema.json (kept equal by a tooling test) and are listed as explicit properties. Any OTHER key (a HUD added after this app was built) is tolerated by the envelope as long as its value is a well-formed ConfigEntry: the client drops each unknown key individually (`unknown-hud`) and still applies the known ones, so an envelope carrying {v2, v3} still delivers the v2 update to a v2-only app (Story 1.13 code review, decision D1 — Stephane, 2026-10-04). Unknown keys are what make adding a HUD forward-compatible; a change to the entry or envelope SHAPE still needs an `envelope_version` bump. At least one entry.

ConfigEntry.description: One HUD's config, carried as text so its key order survives Firestore.

config_json.description: The emitted `map_config.<hud_version>.json` file text, verbatim. Must itself validate against map-config.schema.json, and its `hud_version` must equal this entry's key.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of `config_json`'s UTF-8 bytes (integrity: catches a truncated or hand-edited paste).
